sections.heading: C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Driver Licenses and ID Cards
sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Driver Licenses and ID Cards

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A01
Residency turns on domicile, voting, or filings, while the 30-day clock binds working or schooling newcomers only [A01].
Why it matters: group residency; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F01, sec01-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A01
Immigrants hold permanent residence, non-immigrants visit briefly for a purpose, and citizens were born or naturalized here [A01].
Why it matters: group legal-status; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A01
A home-state license alone excuses a visitor sixteen or up, but an international permit works only beside the home-country license [A01].
Why it matters: group exemptions; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A02
Most listed foreign and domestic licenses waive both Class E exams, German ones waive skills only, and kept Canadian cards force everything [A02].
Why it matters: group reciprocity; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A02
Class E stops below 26,001 pounds while commercial duty starts there, at sixteen passengers, or with placarded cargo [A02].
Why it matters: group license-classes; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F06, sec01-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A03
Originals and certified copies pass, photocopies and notarized copies fail, and name gaps need a linking court or family paper [A03].
Why it matters: group documents; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F08 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A03
Citizens, immigrants, Canadians, and non-immigrants each follow a separate primary-identification track with no mixing [A03].
Why it matters: group identity-tracks; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F09, sec01-F10 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A04
A 60-day photo-free permit bridges agency verification, while failed primary and secondary checks end in denial [A04].
Why it matters: group verification; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F12 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A05
Secondary identification needs one listed item for the numberless, while address proof always needs two residence papers [A05].
Why it matters: group documents; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F14, sec01-F15 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A06
Learner entry opens at 15 with training and two tests, and full licensure at 16 adds identification plus the skills test [A06].
Why it matters: group teen-path; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F17 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A06
Licensure under eighteen combines twelve months with a learner license or reaching age eighteen first, twelve conviction-free months aside from one withheld-adjudication moving violation, fifty practice hours with ten at night certified by a parent, guardian, or responsible adult twenty-one or older, parental consent, and school attendance compliance [A06].
Why it matters: group teen-path; difficulty high; prereq sec01-R10; confusables sec01-F18 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A06
The substance course binds every never-licensed seeker, yet certified school driver-education graduates skip it [A06].
Why it matters: group teen-path; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F19 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-R13 | anchor: A07
A consenting adult accepts driving responsibility and may rescind it to cancel, while married and emancipated minors bypass consent [A07].
Why it matters: group parental-consent; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F20 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec01-R14 | anchor: A08
Employment-only travel covers job trips while business-only reach extends to school, worship, and medical needs [A08].
Why it matters: group restrictions; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F22, sec01-F23 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec01-R15 | anchor: A09
Identification cards run 4 years for the young and 8 beyond, and no driver may hold a license and a card together [A09].
Why it matters: group id-cards; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F24 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R16 | anchor: A09
Career offenders answer within 2 working days while sexual offenders and predators answer within 48 hours [A09].
Why it matters: group designations; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F25, sec01-F26 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R17 | anchor: A10
Offender cards carry the statute tag while predator cards carry the predator label, and post boxes never count as home [A10].
Why it matters: group designations; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-R16; confusables sec01-F27 [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec01-R18 | anchor: A10
Any address move forces a new license within 30 days, and a stale card risks missed mail plus a citation [A10].
Why it matters: group updates; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F29 [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec01-R19 | anchor: A11
Class E renewal covers six to eight years upon showing your prior license and passing a vision exam, while ineligibility, an unanswered traffic summons, a suspended, revoked, or canceled license, or missing required documents prevents renewal [A11].
Why it matters: group renewal; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F33 [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec01-R20 | anchor: A11
Theft victims with a police report replace free, while the long-unissued must rebuild the full document set [A11].
Why it matters: group replacement; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F31, sec01-F32 [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec01-R21 | anchor: A12
Online renewal serves qualified citizens and immigrants but shuts out the recently remote-renewed and the suspended [A12].
Why it matters: group renewal; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-R19; confusables sec01-F34 [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec01-R22 | anchor: A12
Licenses and renewals cost $48, replacements and ID cards $25, and late renewals add $15 [A12].
Why it matters: group fees; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F36 [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec01-R23 | anchor: A13
Revocation cures at $75, suspension at $45, and most payment lapses at $60 against fraud at $180 [A13].
Why it matters: group fees; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F37 [A13].
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec01-R24 | anchor: A13
Liability lapses cure at $15 while injury-protection tiers climb $150, $250, then $500 inside three years [A13].
Why it matters: group fees; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F38 [A13].
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec01-R25 | anchor: A13
Knowledge retests cost $10 against $20 for skills, and fully disabled veterans pay nothing for licenses or IDs [A13].
Why it matters: group fees; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F39 [A13].
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0023]
